Jesse (AE): quick one — OptiHealth wants Net75 + annual upfront for a 1yr commitment. asking if we can split upfront across 2 invoices. they want POC start next month.
Tara (AE): deal is $180k ARR, 1yr, interested in 50% upfront but needs Net75 on remaining balance. customer asks for 2-invoice schedule to match their procurement.
Jesse (AE): yes, PO will reference Redwood SOW. asking finance if this is ok and if we need a credit check.
Sophia (Finance): we can do Net75 but need risk signoff for >60 days. request: credit check + AP contact + billing email. suggest: 40% upfront invoice within 30d, 60% Net75. :thinking_face: 
Alex (Deal Desk): pinging to confirm — any pricing/alterm? Rate card wise 10% discount tied to annual upfront. if we only get 40% upfront we can't give full commit discount. need to know how much upfront they will pay to apply tiered pricing.
OptiHealth (Buyer): hi — procurement here. We can do 45% upfront within 30 days, remainder Net75 from invoice. Can you provide draft invoice dates? We also require invoice to show PO number.
Manny (Legal): add standard late fee/interest clause and PO reference in invoice. Also want to confirm data residency and SLA references in SOW before countersign.
Sophia (Finance): ok. if 45% upfront we can approve 7.5% commit discount (pro-rated). Need credit check + W-9. Also prefer two invoices: Invoice A for upfront, Invoice B for remainder with Net75 terms.
Jesse (AE): thanks. i'll send credit form and W-9 now. drafting invoice schedule — proposing:
```
Invoice A: 45% of contract value, due 30 days after invoice date (upon PO)
Invoice B: 55% of contract value, due Net75 from invoice B date
```
Tara (AE): customer asked whether we can split invoice B into quarterly to help cashflow — they asked for 55% to be split into 3x payments Net75 each. we should confirm with finance.
Sophia (Finance): quarterly splits on the remainder add complexity + collections risk. we can do monthly installments only with escrow or a payment plan doc. prefer single remainder invoice Net75. if customer insists, require payment plan signed and a 2% fee.
Alex (Deal Desk): to get the 10% annual-top discount we need >=50% upfront. so if OptiHealth does 50% upfront we can approve full commit discount. else we cap discount at 7.5%. Need revenue recognition note for finance.
OptiHealth (Buyer): we can stretch to 50% upfront to qualify for full discount, but need the payment schedule in writing and Redwood acceptance. can you draft invoice/terms and send to finance@optihealth.com?
Sophia (Finance): copying finance@optihealth.com is fine. we'll prepare draft invoices and billing instructions. one caveat — Net75 on remainder requires credit form + payment guarantor. i'll add that to the email. :thumbsup: 
Manny (Legal): i'll prepare a concise amendment to SOW capturing invoice schedule, late fees, and PO requirement. Quick Q — any prepaid escrow or security deposit needed?
Jesse (AE): customer prefers no escrow. they offered an AP reference instead. sending draft email now. cc: Alex, Sophia, Manny.
finance-bot: approval-request sent to Finance Approvers group — awaiting manual sign-off.
Alex (Deal Desk): once finance sign-off is in, i'll route to revenue ops for booking and apply discount tier accordingly.
Tara (AE): thanks team. i'll update the customer and attach the draft invoice and amended SOW.
OptiHealth (Buyer): confirmed receipt. we'll review and revert within 48 hours.
Sophia (Finance): noted — will push to get credit check back faster. reaching out to collections for brief.
Jesse (AE): great — keeping this thread for final approval. will post final signed docs here when done. :v:
